_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §EU] Walls of fitted stone for Torchfire 1's ruins: the Inca way, every stone its own polygon, fitted with no mortar; real relief, never a normal map; settled with age; overgrown only where it would really grow. First guesses by Claude (chat), 6 Oct; Claude Code matches the shape to its generator (keep the meaning, rename freely) and Mike tunes by playing. Restart after editing.
_help.built_as: Claude Code, 6 Oct: §EU is built from data/dungeon/masonry.json, the file Mike's 6 Oct message named (same meaning, the generator's own shape: one preset for the tomb, a humidity model for the overgrowth). This file is not read; which of the two stays is Mike's call (flagged in PROGRESS).
_help.partition: How a wall face is cut into stones. method: voronoi (one cell per stone on the wall plane). seed_per_face: every wall face takes its own seed, so joints never mirror across a corridor (Mike's 6 Oct note). relax_steps: smoothing passes so cells are rounder and more even (0 = raw, more = more regular). corner_rule: stones at a wall's corner wrap or stop at the edge (stop is the first guess; wrap if the corners look cut).
_help.relief: Real geometry (R-rules: no normal maps, no shine). proud_m: how far a stone's face stands out from the wall plane [min, max]. pillow_m: how much its face bulges in the middle. bevel_m: the rounded edge's width. joint_m: the gap left between stones at the face. joint_depth_m: how deep the joints sink. joint_occlusion: baked occlusion in the joints, tinted to the scene's shade colour (navy, olive in green scenes, never grey; §ES.2). The torch's live light catches the pillowed faces.
_help.settle: Fitted but settled (§EU.3): share of stones that have moved; offset_m: in (negative) or out (positive) [min, max]; tilt_deg [min, max]; dropped_share: stones fallen out of their place (rare; a collapsed room, crawler.json kit.kinds collapsed, is where the rubble lives).
_help.overgrowth: §EU.4: only where it would really grow. climate: the moisture and temperature gate is vines.json climate (moisture[0] none, moisture[1] full, fades outside temp_c, shade_boost). moss_in_joints: moss gathers in the recessed joints first. moss_low_wall_m: moss climbs the shaded lower wall to this height at full climate. vines: vines from cracks and wall tops, the biome's own vine species, drawn per vines.json. dry: where the climate gives no moss, sand and dust drift into corners (drift_corner_m deep).
_help.presets: §EU.5. stone_m: a stone's typical width [min, max]; course_bias: 0 = free polygons, 1 = loosely in courses (rows); tint: the stone's colour (sRGB hex) or "theme" for the stage's existing stone colour. megalithic: a few huge stones (Sacsayhuamán). fitted_small: many tight stones.
_help.by_theme: Which preset each crawler.json theme uses (first guess, open for Mike, §EU). Per world with §EW (worlds.json).
